name: 约翰·麦卡锡
bio_short: 美国计算机科学家，被誉为“人工智能之父”之一。他在1956年发起并组织了达特茅斯会议（`dartmouth_ai_conference_1956`），首次提出了“人工智能”这一术语。此外，他还是LISP编程语言的发明者，并最早提出了计算机“分时系统”（Time-sharing）的概念，极大地推动了计算机科学的发展。
bio_short_en: An American computer scientist, considered one of the 'Fathers of Artificial Intelligence'. He organized the Dartmouth Conference in 1956 (`dartmouth_ai_conference_1956`), where he coined the term 'Artificial Intelligence'. Additionally, he invented the Lisp programming language and pioneered the concept of computer 'Time-sharing', significantly advancing the field of computer science.
